name: ABSTRACT_PAGE_TYPE
title: Abstract page type
userMessage: Pages cannot be created with an abstract page type. Abstract types are for structural purposes only.
staticHint: This page type is abstract and cannot hold pages. Use GET /public/v1/page-types and select entries where abstractType is false to find concrete page types.

name: ACCOUNT_NOT_ACTIVE
title: Account not active
userMessage: Your account is no longer active. Please sign in again.

name: API_KEY_EXPIRED
title: API key expired
userMessage: API key has expired.
staticHint: This API key has expired. Create or renew a key in the Normatik UI under API keys.

name: API_KEY_INVALID
title: Invalid API key
userMessage: The provided API key is not valid.
staticHint: Send the API key as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'. Keys are managed in the Normatik UI under API keys.

name: API_KEY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED
title: API key limit exceeded
userMessage: You have reached the maximum number of active API keys. Delete an existing key before creating a new one.

name: API_KEY_NOT_FOUND
title: API key not found
userMessage: The API key does not exist or has been deleted.

name: API_KEY_READ_ONLY
title: API key is read-only
userMessage: This API key is read-only and cannot be used for write operations.
staticHint: This key is read-only. Use a FULL-access API key for write operations.

name: AUDIT_LOG_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND
title: Audit log entry not found
userMessage: The audit log entry you're looking for doesn't exist.

name: CANNOT_DELETE_SELF
title: Cannot delete your own account
userMessage: You cannot delete your own account.

name: CHILD_TYPE_PROPERTY_DESCRIPTOR_IN_USE
title: Child type property in use
userMessage: This property is used to determine allowed child types and cannot be changed or deleted.

name: CLI_AUTH_KEY_ALREADY_DELIVERED
title: CLI login key already delivered
userMessage: This CLI login was approved and its API key was already delivered once. If your CLI did not receive it, a new key exists on the server: check your Profile and revoke it if unexpected.

name: CLI_AUTH_NONCE_INVALID
title: CLI login code invalid
userMessage: This CLI login code is invalid, has expired, or has already been used. Start a new login from the CLI.

name: CONCURRENT_UPDATE
title: Concurrent update
userMessage: This item was modified by someone else. Refresh and try again.

name: CONTENT_MACRO_NOT_FOUND
title: Content macro not found
userMessage: The content macro doesn't exist or its module is not enabled.

name: CONTENT_VALIDATION_FAILED
title: Content validation failed
userMessage: The content contains one or more validation errors. See diagnostics for details.

name: CRYPTO_MISCONFIGURED
title: Crypto configuration invalid
userMessage: The encryption configuration is invalid (non-hex salt or incompatible key/salt). Contact your administrator.

name: CSP_REPORT_TOO_LARGE
title: CSP report too large
userMessage: The CSP report payload exceeds the maximum allowed size.

name: CYCLE_DETECTED
title: Invalid page type parent
userMessage: A page type cannot be placed under itself or one of its descendants.
staticHint: Placing this page type under the selected parent would create a cycle. Use GET /public/v1/page-types to inspect the current hierarchy before retrying.

name: DATA_TYPE_CHANGE_NOT_ALLOWED
title: Data type change not allowed
userMessage: The data type cannot be changed because values already exist for this property.
staticHint: The data type of a property descriptor cannot be changed once values exist. Create a new descriptor with the desired type instead.

name: DATE_TIME_FORMAT_INVALID
title: Invalid date-time format
userMessage: The value must be in ZonedDateTime format with a bracketed IANA zone, e.g. '2026-05-19T22:00:00[Europe/Amsterdam]'.

name: DATE_TIME_ZONE_UNKNOWN
title: Unknown time zone
userMessage: The bracketed zone identifier is not a recognized IANA time zone ID.

name: DESCRIPTOR_IN_USE
title: Descriptor referenced in formula
userMessage: This descriptor cannot be deleted or changed because one or more CALCULATED descriptors reference it in their formula.

name: DISPLAY_COLUMN_REQUIRES_PAGE_TYPE
title: Display columns require page type
userMessage: Display columns can only be configured for PAGE type property descriptors.

name: DUPLICATE_EMAIL
title: Email address already exists
userMessage: A user with this email address already exists. Please choose a different email.

name: DUPLICATE_GROUP_NAME
title: Group name already exists
userMessage: A group with this name already exists. Please choose a different name.

name: DUPLICATE_INTEGRATION_SETTING
title: Duplicate integration setting
userMessage: A setting for this integration already exists.

name: ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND
title: Endpoint not found
userMessage: The requested endpoint does not exist on this API.
staticHint: This endpoint does not exist. Public API resources live under /public/v1: pages, page-types, property-descriptors, domain-enums, users, groups, workflow, workflow-roles, work-item-types, content, content-macros, landing-settings, release-notes, admin/trash, admin/archive, admin/audit.

name: ENUM_CHANGE_NOT_ALLOWED
title: Enum change not allowed
userMessage: The enum cannot be changed because values already exist for this property.
staticHint: The linked domain enum of a property descriptor cannot be changed once values exist. Create a new descriptor with the desired enum instead.

name: EXPAND_UNKNOWN_KEY
title: Unknown expand key
userMessage: One or more expand keys are not recognized. Check the validKeys field for allowed values.

name: FILE_ATTACHMENT_NOT_FOUND
title: File attachment not found
userMessage: The file attachment you're looking for doesn't exist or has been deleted.

name: FILE_TOO_LARGE
title: File too large
userMessage: The uploaded file exceeds the maximum allowed size.

name: GOOGLE_DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED
title: Domain not allowed
userMessage: Google login failed: the account's domain is not allowed for this instance.

name: GOOGLE_DOMAIN_NOT_CONFIGURED
title: Domain not configured
userMessage: Google login is disabled: no allowed domain has been configured for this instance.

name: GOOGLE_LINK_ALREADY_LINKED
title: User already linked
userMessage: Google login failed: this user account is already linked to a different Google identity.

name: GOOGLE_LINK_EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED
title: Email not verified
userMessage: Google login failed: the email address is not verified by Google.

name: GOOGLE_LINK_IDENTITY_MISMATCH
title: Identity mismatch
userMessage: Google login failed: the Google account's email or domain no longer matches the linked local user.

name: GOOGLE_LINK_NO_LOCAL_USER
title: No local user found
userMessage: Google login failed: no local user account found for this email address.

name: GOOGLE_LINK_USER_DELETED
title: User account deleted
userMessage: Google login failed: the associated user account has been deleted.

name: IMAGE_NOT_FOUND
title: Image not found
userMessage: The image you're looking for doesn't exist or has been deleted.

name: INSUFFICIENT_ROLE
title: Insufficient role
userMessage: You do not have the required role to perform this action.

name: INSUFFICIENT_WORKFLOW_ROLE
title: Insufficient workflow role
userMessage: You do not have the required workflow role to perform this action.

name: INTEGRATION_DISABLED
title: Integration disabled
userMessage: This feature is not available because the required integration is disabled.

name: INTEGRATION_NOT_CONFIGURABLE
title: Integration not configurable
userMessage: This integration cannot be configured. Only JIRA is configurable.

name: INTEGRATION_NOT_FOUND
title: Integration not found
userMessage: The requested integration does not exist.

name: INTERNAL_ERROR
title: Internal error
userMessage: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again or contact support with the correlation ID.

name: INVALID_CHAIN_LINK
title: Invalid chain link
userMessage: One or more chain links in the PROPERTY_CHAIN configuration are invalid.

name: INVALID_CHILD_PAGE
title: Invalid child page
userMessage: One or more of the provided page IDs are not children of the specified parent page.
staticHint: One or more provided IDs are not children of the given parent. Use GET /public/v1/pages/tree to inspect the correct child pages and their IDs.

name: INVALID_CHILD_TYPE_PROPERTY_DESCRIPTOR
title: Invalid child type property descriptor
userMessage: The selected property descriptor is not valid for determining child types.

name: INVALID_COLOR_BAND
title: Invalid color band configuration
userMessage: One or more color bands have invalid values: check hex format (#RRGGBB), from <= to, and no overlapping ranges.

name: INVALID_CONDITIONAL_ENUM_CONFIG
title: Invalid conditional enum configuration
userMessage: The CONDITIONAL_ENUM property descriptor configuration is invalid.

name: INVALID_DISPLAY_COLUMN
title: Invalid display column
userMessage: The specified display column descriptor is not valid for the configured page type.

name: INVALID_DISPLAY_COLUMN_SORT
title: Invalid display column sort
userMessage: The provided display column ID list does not match the current display columns.

name: INVALID_DISPLAY_COLUMN_WIDTH
title: Invalid display column width
userMessage: Display column widths must sum to 100%.

name: INVALID_FILE_TYPE
title: Invalid file type
userMessage: This file type is not allowed or the file exceeds the maximum size of 50 MB.

name: INVALID_FORMULA
title: Invalid formula
userMessage: The formula references an invalid descriptor. Only NUMBER descriptors on the same page type may be referenced; calc-to-calc and cross-type references are not allowed.

name: INVALID_IMAGE_TYPE
title: Invalid image type
userMessage: Only JPG and PNG images are allowed with a maximum size of 10 MB.

name: INVALID_INCOMING_SOURCE_DESCRIPTOR
title: Invalid incoming source descriptor
userMessage: The incomingSourceDescriptorId configuration for the PAGE_INCOMING property is invalid.

name: INVALID_PAGE_SELECTOR_CONFIG
title: Invalid page selector configuration
userMessage: The PAGE_SELECTOR property descriptor configuration is invalid.

name: INVALID_PARENT_PAGE_TYPE
title: Invalid parent page type
userMessage: This page type is not allowed as a child of the selected parent page.
staticHint: This page type is not allowed as a child of the selected parent. Use GET /public/v1/page-types to check allowedChildTypes on the parent type.

name: INVALID_REQUEST
title: Invalid request
userMessage: The request could not be processed.

name: INVALID_SORT
title: Invalid sort key
userMessage: The requested sort is not allowed for this endpoint.

name: INVALID_TRANSITION
title: Invalid status transition
userMessage: The requested status transition is not allowed from the current status.

name: JIRA_BAD_REQUEST
title: Jira request failed
userMessage: The request to Jira failed. Please check your query and try again.

name: JIRA_CONFIG_MISSING
title: Jira configuration missing
userMessage: No Jira configuration found. Configure the Jira integration in the admin settings.

name: JIRA_DECRYPT_FAILED
title: Jira secret decryption failed
userMessage: A Jira secret could not be decrypted. The encryption key may be incorrect.

name: JIRA_KEY_MISSING
title: Jira encryption key missing
userMessage: The Jira encryption key is not configured. Contact your administrator.

name: JIRA_NOT_FOUND
title: Jira resource not found
userMessage: The requested Jira resource could not be found.

name: JIRA_UNAVAILABLE
title: Jira unavailable
userMessage: Jira is currently unavailable. Please try again later.

name: METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED
title: Method not allowed
userMessage: The HTTP method is not supported for this endpoint.
staticHint: This HTTP method is not supported here. Check the allowedMethods field in this response.

name: MIGRATE_PUBLISH_ALREADY_PUBLISHED
title: Already published
userMessage: Cannot migrate-publish: a PUBLISHED revision already exists. The migrate-publish endpoint is intended for one-time migration of new content and cannot republish pages that have already been through a publishing cycle.

name: MIGRATE_PUBLISH_NO_STORED_REVISION
title: No stored revision
userMessage: Cannot migrate-publish: no STORED revision exists. The migrate-publish endpoint is intended for content migration only and operates outside the regular publishing workflow.

name: MOVE_IMPACT_DIVERGED
title: Move impact diverged
userMessage: The page type tree has changed since the impact preview was computed. Please refresh and retry.
staticHint: Retry without the snapshot field - the server then performs an implicit impact preview before executing the move.

name: NOT_A_ROOT_PAGE
title: Not a root page
userMessage: One or more of the provided page IDs are not root pages (they have a parent).
staticHint: One or more provided IDs are not root pages. Use GET /public/v1/pages/tree to list all root pages and their IDs.

name: NUMBER_OUT_OF_RANGE
title: Number value out of range
userMessage: The provided value falls outside the configured minimum or maximum for this property.

name: PAGE_ACCESS_CONFIGURATION_ERROR
title: Page access misconfiguration
userMessage: A security check could not be completed due to a server configuration error.

name: PAGE_ACCESS_DENIED
title: Access denied
userMessage: You do not have access to this page.
staticHint: Your API key does not have read access to this page. Check restriction details via GET /public/v1/pages/{id}?expand=restriction (admin key required).

name: PAGE_ARCHIVE_BLOCKED_BY_CHILDREN
title: Page has active children
userMessage: This page cannot be archived because it has active child pages. Archive or move the child pages first.
staticHint: Archive or move the active child pages first. Use GET /public/v1/pages/tree to list them in sort order.

name: PAGE_CASCADE_PUBLISHED_ACKNOWLEDGMENT_REQUIRED
title: Published acknowledgment required
userMessage: This cascade affects one or more published pages. Retry with acknowledgePublished=true to confirm they will go offline.
staticHint: Retry the cascade with acknowledgePublished=true after confirming published pages may go offline.

name: PAGE_CASCADE_WRITE_ACCESS_DENIED
title: Cascade blocked by write access
userMessage: The cascade cannot proceed because one or more pages lack write access. Visible blockers are listed; restricted pages are counted only.

name: PAGE_HAS_CHILDREN
title: Page has children
userMessage: This page cannot be deleted because it has child pages. Delete the child pages first.
staticHint: Move or delete the child pages first. Use GET /public/v1/pages/tree to list them in sort order.

name: PAGE_INCOMING_NOT_EDITABLE
title: Incoming page relation not editable
userMessage: PAGE_INCOMING properties are read-only and must be managed from the linked outgoing property.

name: PAGE_NAME_EXISTS
title: Page name already exists
userMessage: A page with this name already exists. Please choose a different name.

name: PAGE_NOT_ARCHIVED
title: Page not archived
userMessage: This operation can only be performed on pages that are archived.

name: PAGE_NOT_FOUND
title: Page not found
userMessage: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has been deleted.

name: PAGE_NOT_IN_TRASH
title: Page not in trash
userMessage: This operation can only be performed on pages that are in the trash.

name: PAGE_PARENT_CYCLE
title: Invalid page parent
userMessage: A page cannot be placed under itself or one of its descendants.

name: PAGE_RESTORE_BLOCKED_BY_PARENT
title: Parent page is cancelled
userMessage: This page cannot be restored because its parent is archived or in the trash. Restore the parent page first.
staticHint: Restore the parent page first. Use GET /public/v1/pages/tree to inspect the hierarchy.

name: PAGE_RESTRICTION_ACCESS_ALREADY_EXISTS
title: Access entry already exists
userMessage: This user already has an access entry for this page restriction.

name: PAGE_RESTRICTION_ACCESS_NOT_FOUND
title: Access entry not found
userMessage: The access entry was not found.

name: PAGE_RESTRICTION_ALREADY_EXISTS
title: Page restriction already exists
userMessage: This page already has a restriction. A page can only have one restriction.

name: PAGE_RESTRICTION_CANNOT_ADD_USER
title: Cannot add user
userMessage: This user is not eligible to be added to this restriction. Only users from the parent restriction can be invited.

name: PAGE_RESTRICTION_CANNOT_UPGRADE_ACCESS
title: Cannot upgrade access
userMessage: Access level cannot be upgraded on a child restriction. Only downgrades are allowed.

name: PAGE_RESTRICTION_GROUP_ACCESS_ALREADY_EXISTS
title: Group access entry already exists
userMessage: This group already has an access entry for this page restriction.

name: PAGE_RESTRICTION_NOT_FOUND
title: Restriction not found
userMessage: No restriction is set on this page.

name: PAGE_RESTRICTION_NOT_OWNER
title: Not the restriction owner
userMessage: Only the restriction owner can perform this action.

name: PAGE_TRASH_BLOCKED_BY_CHILDREN
title: Page has child pages
userMessage: This page cannot be moved to trash because it has child pages that are not in the trash. Move the child pages to trash first.
staticHint: Move the non-trashed child pages to trash first. Use GET /public/v1/pages/tree to list them in sort order.

name: PAGE_TYPE_HAS_PAGES
title: Page type has pages
userMessage: This page type cannot be marked as abstract because concrete pages of this type already exist.
staticHint: This page type has existing pages and cannot be made abstract. List all pages of this type via GET /public/v1/pages?pageTypeId={id}.

name: PAGE_TYPE_IN_USE
title: Page type in use
userMessage: This page type cannot be deleted because it's being used by pages or as a parent type.
staticHint: This page type is referenced by existing pages or types and cannot be deleted. List all pages of this type via GET /public/v1/pages?pageTypeId={id}.

name: PAGE_TYPE_NAME_EXISTS
title: Page type name already exists
userMessage: A page type with this name already exists. Please choose a different name.

name: PAGE_TYPE_NOT_FOUND
title: Page type not found
userMessage: The page type doesn't exist or has been deleted.
staticHint: Page type not found. Use GET /public/v1/page-types to list all valid page type IDs.

name: PAGE_TYPE_PARENT_CHANGE_NOT_ALLOWED
title: Parent change not allowed
userMessage: The parent of a page type cannot be changed via this endpoint. Use POST /api/page-types/{id}/move to reparent a page type.
staticHint: Use POST /public/v1/page-types/{id}/move to reparent a page type.

name: PAGE_UNARCHIVE_BLOCKED_BY_PARENT
title: Parent page is cancelled
userMessage: This page cannot be unarchived because its parent is archived or in the trash. Unarchive or restore the parent page first.
staticHint: Unarchive or restore the parent page first. Use GET /public/v1/pages/tree to inspect the hierarchy.

name: PAGE_WRITE_ACCESS_DENIED
title: Write access denied
userMessage: You do not have write access to this page.
staticHint: Your API key does not have write access to this page. Check restriction details via GET /public/v1/pages/{id}?expand=restriction (admin key required).

name: PARENT_PAGE_NOT_EDITABLE
title: Parent page not editable
userMessage: PARENT_PAGE properties are read-only and cannot be created, updated or deleted.

name: PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN_INVALID
title: Password reset link invalid
userMessage: This password reset link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.

name: PASSWORD_TOO_WEAK
title: Password too weak
userMessage: The chosen password does not meet the strength requirements.

name: PROPERTY_DESCRIPTOR_CONTAINS_THIS_PAGE_IN_USE
title: Property descriptor referenced as contains-this-page constraint
userMessage: This property cannot be deleted because one or more PAGE_SELECTOR properties use it as a relational constraint.

name: PROPERTY_DESCRIPTOR_IN_USE
title: Property descriptor in use
userMessage: This property cannot be deleted because it has values on existing pages.

name: PROPERTY_DESCRIPTOR_INCOMING_SOURCE_IN_USE
title: Property descriptor referenced by incoming relation
userMessage: This property cannot be deleted because one or more PAGE_INCOMING properties depend on it.

name: PROPERTY_DESCRIPTOR_LAYOUT_INVALID
title: Property descriptor layout invalid
userMessage: The provided layout is invalid: it must contain exactly the effective descriptor set without duplicates or nulls, and inherited descriptors may not be reordered.

name: PROPERTY_DESCRIPTOR_MISMATCH
title: Property descriptor mismatch
userMessage: The property value does not match the selected property.

name: PROPERTY_DESCRIPTOR_NAME_EXISTS
title: Property name already exists
userMessage: A property with this name already exists on this page type. Please choose a different name.

name: PROPERTY_DESCRIPTOR_NOT_AVAILABLE_FOR_PAGE
title: Property not available for page
userMessage: The selected property does not belong to this page type.
staticHint: The property descriptor does not belong to this page type. Use GET /public/v1/page-types/{id}/available-property-descriptors to list valid descriptor IDs.

name: PROPERTY_DESCRIPTOR_NOT_FOUND
title: Property descriptor not found
userMessage: The property doesn't exist or has been deleted.

name: PROPERTY_DESCRIPTOR_OWN_NOT_HIDEABLE
title: Own property descriptor not hideable
userMessage: This property is declared directly on the page type and cannot be hidden or unhidden. Only inherited properties support visibility overrides.

name: PROPERTY_DESCRIPTOR_SORT_INVALID
title: Property descriptor sort invalid
userMessage: The provided property descriptor list does not match the page type.

name: PROPERTY_DESCRIPTOR_SWAP_INVALID
title: Property descriptor swap invalid
userMessage: The selected properties cannot be swapped because they belong to different page types.

name: PROPERTY_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_SOURCE_IN_USE
title: Property descriptor referenced as type source
userMessage: This property cannot be deleted because one or more PAGE_SELECTOR properties use it as a type source.

name: PROPERTY_ENUM_IN_USE
title: Property enum in use
userMessage: This enum cannot be deleted because it's being used by properties.
staticHint: This domain enum is referenced by property descriptors, work item types, or pages. Inspect its usages via GET /public/v1/domain-enums/{id}/usages before deleting.

name: PROPERTY_ENUM_NAME_EXISTS
title: Property enum name already exists
userMessage: An enum with this name already exists. Please choose a different name.

name: PROPERTY_ENUM_NOT_FOUND
title: Property enum not found
userMessage: The enum doesn't exist or has been deleted.
staticHint: Domain enum not found. Use GET /public/v1/domain-enums to list all available domain enums with their IDs.

name: PROPERTY_ENUM_VALUE_EXISTS
title: Enum value already exists
userMessage: A value with this name already exists in this enum. Please choose a different name.

name: PROPERTY_ENUM_VALUE_IN_USE
title: Enum value in use
userMessage: This enum value cannot be removed because it's being used by pages.
staticHint: This enum value is used in published page property values. Inspect its usages via GET /public/v1/domain-enums/{id}/usages to see which pages reference it.

name: PROPERTY_ENUM_VALUE_USED_IN_TRIGGER
title: Enum value used in trigger
userMessage: This enum value cannot be removed because it's referenced by a conditional enum trigger.

name: PROPERTY_NOT_WRITABLE
title: Property not writable
userMessage: This property has a read-only or computed data type and its value cannot be set.
staticHint: This property has a read-only or computed data type and cannot be set. Use GET /public/v1/page-types/{id} to inspect each property descriptor dataType and target only writable properties.

name: PROPERTY_VALUE_NOT_FOUND
title: Property value not found
userMessage: The property value doesn't exist or has been deleted.

name: RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED
title: Too many requests
userMessage: You've made too many requests recently. Please wait a minute before trying again.
staticHint: Rate limit reached. Wait the number of seconds given in retryAfterSeconds (also in the Retry-After header) before retrying.

name: RELEASE_NOTE_NOT_FOUND
title: Release note not found
userMessage: The requested release note version does not exist.
staticHint: Use GET /public/v1/release-notes to list available release note versions.

name: REPLACEMENT_OWNER_CANNOT_BE_SELF
title: Cannot replace with self
userMessage: The replacement owner cannot be the user being deleted.

name: REPLACEMENT_OWNER_INVALID
title: Replacement owner invalid
userMessage: The selected replacement owner doesn't exist or isn't active. Pick another user.
staticHint: The replacement owner does not exist or is not active. Refresh the candidate list via GET /public/v1/users/{id}/permanent-delete-replacements and choose a valid user.

name: REPLACEMENT_OWNER_NOT_ELIGIBLE
title: Replacement owner not eligible
userMessage: The selected replacement owner is no longer eligible. Refresh the candidate list and try again.
staticHint: The selected replacement is no longer eligible (restrictions may have changed). Refresh the candidate list via GET /public/v1/users/{id}/permanent-delete-replacements and choose again.

name: REPLACEMENT_OWNER_REQUIRED
title: Replacement owner required
userMessage: Permanent delete requires picking a replacement owner because this user locks one or more pages.
staticHint: This user owns page restrictions and requires a replacement owner. Fetch eligible candidates via GET /public/v1/users/{id}/permanent-delete-replacements.

name: REVISION_NOT_EDITABLE
title: Revision not editable
userMessage: Only revisions in STORED status can be edited.
staticHint: The working revision is not in STORED status and cannot be edited. Use GET /public/v1/pages/{id}/revisions to check the current status, or POST /public/v1/pages/{id}/revisions/start to create a new STORED revision.

name: REVISION_NOT_FOUND
title: Revision not found
userMessage: The requested revision does not exist.

name: SORT_NOT_ALLOWED
title: Sort not allowed
userMessage: Sorting is not enabled for children of this page. The parent page type does not have sortableChildPages enabled.
staticHint: Sorting is not enabled for this page type. Use GET /public/v1/page-types/{id} to check if sortableChildPages is enabled on the parent page type.

name: USER_GROUP_NOT_FOUND
title: User group not found
userMessage: The user group you're looking for doesn't exist.
staticHint: Use GET /public/v1/groups to list all groups and verify the group ID.

name: USER_NOT_DELETED
title: User is not deleted
userMessage: Permanent delete is only allowed on users that have been soft-deleted first.

name: USER_NOT_FOUND
title: User not found
userMessage: The user you're looking for doesn't exist or has been deleted.
staticHint: Use GET /public/v1/users to list all users and verify the user ID.

name: WORK_ITEM_NOT_FOUND
title: Work item not found
userMessage: The work item you're looking for doesn't exist.

name: WORK_ITEM_TRANSITION_DUPLICATE
title: Duplicate transition
userMessage: A transition with this from/to combination already exists for this work item type.

name: WORK_ITEM_TRANSITION_IN_USE
title: Work item transition in use
userMessage: This transition cannot be deleted because existing work items would be left with no outgoing transitions.

name: WORK_ITEM_TRANSITION_INVALID_VALUE
title: Invalid enum value for transition
userMessage: The specified enum value does not belong to the domain enum of this work item type.

name: WORK_ITEM_TRANSITION_NOT_FOUND
title: Work item transition not found
userMessage: The work item transition you're looking for doesn't exist.

name: WORK_ITEM_TYPE_DOMAIN_ENUM_LOCKED
title: Work item type domain enum locked by triggers
userMessage: The domain enum cannot be changed because conditional enum triggers reference this work item type.

name: WORK_ITEM_TYPE_IN_USE
title: Work item type in use
userMessage: This work item type cannot be deleted because it has existing work items.

name: WORK_ITEM_TYPE_NOT_FOUND
title: Work item type not found
userMessage: The work item type you're looking for doesn't exist.
staticHint: Work item type not found. Use GET /public/v1/work-item-types to list all available work item types.

name: WORK_ITEM_TYPE_SLUG_EXISTS
title: Work item type slug already exists
userMessage: A work item type with this slug already exists. Please choose a different slug.

name: WORK_ITEM_TYPE_SLUG_IMMUTABLE
title: Work item type slug is immutable
userMessage: The slug of a work item type cannot be changed after creation.

name: WORK_ITEM_TYPE_SLUG_INVALID
title: Work item type slug invalid
userMessage: The slug must be lowercase alphanumeric segments separated by single hyphens (e.g. my-work-item). Leading and trailing hyphens and consecutive hyphens are not allowed.

name: WORKFLOW_BYPASS_NOT_ALLOWED
title: Workflow edit not allowed
userMessage: This page has publishing workflow enabled. Use the revision endpoints to edit content.
staticHint: This page type has publishing workflow enabled. Use POST /public/v1/pages/{id}/revisions/start to create a working revision, then transition via POST /public/v1/pages/{id}/revisions/transition.

name: WORKFLOW_NOT_ENABLED
title: Workflow not enabled
userMessage: Publishing workflow is not enabled for this page type.

name: WORKING_REVISION_EXISTS
title: Working revision already exists
userMessage: This page already has an active working revision. Complete or discard it before starting a new one.
staticHint: A working revision already exists for this page. Inspect it via GET /public/v1/pages/{id}/revisions/snapshot, or edit it directly via PUT /public/v1/pages/{id}.

name: WORKING_REVISION_NOT_DISCARDABLE
title: Working revision cannot be discarded
userMessage: The working revision cannot be discarded in its current state. Workflow must be enabled, a STORED working revision must exist, and the page must not be in the trash.
